The most popular method in clinical practice for evaluating the visual performance through the field with a Multifocal Intraocular Lens or a Multifocal Contact Lens is the Visual Acuity Defocus Curve. This application allows you to measure Defocus Curves with several advantages versus conventional charts. 

The application is based on a Freemium model, just downloading the App you will have access to the following options:
1.- Visual Acuity Defocus Curves
2.- Two possible distances (2 m and 4 m), 
3.- Selecting a range of possible Defocus Lenses from +5.00 D to -5.00 D 
4.- Snellen optotypes.

BEFORE DOWNLOADING ON IPHONE YOU SHOULD KNOW:

The functionalities differ depending on the installation on an iPad or iPhone:
1.- You need an iPad for conducting the Defocus Curve measurement
2.- If you install the MLA in an iPhone this only serves as a remote control, you will still need an iPad to measure the Defocus Curve
3.- You can access to more information about the procedure at: 
https://defocuscurve.com/en/testing-defocus-curve

A PRO version is also included with several options such as:

5.- Contrast Sensitivity Defocus Curve
6.- Optional steps of +/- 0.25D around de 0D step
7.- Sloan Optotypes (ETDRS)
8.- Auto-calculation of Sphere with Rx, Defocus and Distance
9.-  Remote Control with another IOS device
10.- Historical Database to Store Defocus Curves
11.-  Assign Defocus Curves to several Protocols (MIOLs or MCLs)
12.-  Store Additional information (pupil, Rx, month, etc)
13.-  Export Data to .CSV
14.-  Calibrated considering several iPad models or the possibility of a personalized calibration.
15.- Area under the defocus curve calculation.
